description: Get a project kit: one part per job from AgentGid's catalogs (with version, license and reasons), install lines, checks, and with files=true the AGENTS.md brief, CREDITS.md, first prompt and MCP setup files. Give a recipe id from list_recipes or the goal in plain words. If no recipe fits the goal, it says so and lists the recipes: it never improvises a stack.

add.description: Add up to 8 parts from AgentGid's catalogs that the recipe does not list: item ids such as "tool:pikepdf" or {"item": id, "stage": "agent|build|check|ship"}. They are checked against the answers like every part and marked as added in the files.

files.description: Also return the texts of AGENTS.md, CREDITS.md, first-prompt.txt, install.txt and setup files

goal.description: What to build, in plain words, e.g. 'a Mario-style browser game'

on.description: Switch parts on or off: {role id: true|false}. Optional parts start off. Assets, agent skills and MCP servers can be switched off, and the brief then says they were removed; parts the plan is built on (libraries, runtimes, services) can only be swapped through picks

packs.description: Choose a pack, model or font inside a picked source: {role id: item id}

picks.description: Swap a part: {role id: item id}, ids as in a previous answer's parts[].pick and alternatives

prompt.description: First prompt: stop after each step (default) or run the whole plan

name: plan_project
title: Plan a project from a tested kit
